categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, sales, and service of power semiconductor devices. Key products include high-power thyristors, rectifiers, IGBT modules, power semiconductor modules, and pulse power switches. These products are widely applied in industrial inverters, motor drives, high-power power supplies, digital energy, smart grids, rail transit, and new energy sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs an integrated IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturer) model covering wafer processing, chip design, packaging, and testing. It holds 61 semiconductor patents and proprietary technologies, with advanced capabilities in silicon-based power semiconductors and ongoing R&D in third-generation wide bandgap semiconductors such as SiC and GaN. The company also utilizes new packaging technologies like suspended press-fit and develops pulse power switching technologies at an international leading level.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Customers are mainly from industrial manufacturing, electrical equipment, digital energy, smart grid, rail transit, and new energy industries. The company serves leading enterprises in power electronics applications, including high-end clients in digital energy and special power supply sectors. The top five customers account for about 20% of sales, indicating a diversified customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with domestic sales accounting for over 95% of revenue. It also has limited export sales, approximately 4.3% of total revenue. Key operational locations include its headquarters in Xiangyang, Hubei Province, and subsidiaries in Shanghai and Xiangyang.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as an IDM, covering upstream wafer processing, midstream chip manufacturing, and downstream packaging and testing, thus controlling the full semiconductor device production chain. It is positioned as a midstream to downstream manufacturer and supplier of power semiconductor devices.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include product and market structure optimization, focusing on high-end power semiconductor devices such as IGBT modules and IGCTs, and expanding applications in digital energy, pulse power systems, and new energy sectors. The company emphasizes R&D in third-generation semiconductors (SiC, GaN), pulse power switches, and advanced packaging technologies. It maintains strong industry-academia collaborations and provincial research platforms to accelerate innovation and commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales and regional distribution of semiconductor devices and modules. The company sells physical products (power semiconductor devices) mainly via direct sales channels (about 90%) and some through distributors. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks among the leading domestic manufacturers in the high-power semiconductor device segment, with strong production capacity, product quality, and market share. It holds a leading position in motor drive control and industrial manufacturing equipment applications and is expanding in digital energy and clean energy fields. Competitors include other domestic and international power semiconductor manufacturers, but the company leverages its IDM model and technology patents for competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 354 million, a 10.76% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 25.3 million, down 18.77% from the previous year. The company maintains a net asset base of over RMB 1.1 billion with steady growth in production capacity and sales volume. R&D investment increased to 6.83% of revenue, supporting sustainable growth despite some profit margin pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its vertically integrated IDM model, enabling control over the entire production process and rapid response to market demands. It offers a comprehensive product portfolio with high reliability and quality, supported by extensive patents and proprietary technologies. Its focus on advanced power semiconductor technologies, including third-generation wide bandgap materials and innovative packaging, differentiates it in high-end applications. Strong customer relationships and stable supply capabilities further enhance its market position.
